Extract Top Target Genes for a Ligand

Source: R/RcppExports.R
get_top_targets_cpp.Rd

Extract Top Target Genes for a Ligand

Usage

get_top_targets_cpp(
  ligand_idx,
  ligand_target_matrix,
  target_genes,
  gene_names,
  ligand_names,
  top_n
)

Arguments

ligand_idx

Integer index of the ligand (0-based)

ligand_target_matrix

Matrix of ligand-target scores

target_genes

Character vector of genes in the target set

gene_names

Character vector of all gene names

ligand_names

Character vector of ligand names

top_n

Number of top targets to return

Value

DataFrame with ligand-target links
